turns.question: On 1 and 2 October 2026, how much larger in EUR was the average amount of returns with reason damaged than of returns with reason wrong size?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no metric for the average amount of returns, so I cannot give that difference; the closest metrics are Returns (EUR) and Returns, which for 1 and 2 October 2026 show damaged returns at 12.50 EUR across 1 return and wrong size returns at 5.00 EUR across 1 return.
